messages:
elaine_pm: Quick heads-up — Support Pods (ephemeral, timeboxed remote support) is GA for Private deployments today. Summary: customers can grant Redwood support a short-lived, auditable session (API proxy + limited shell/log access) for up to 4h. Scopes are explicit (logs, tail, shell, metrics) and require tenant opt-in. Audit bundles and signed attestations are produced automatically for every session. Default is DISABLED for existing tenants; new Private tenants will see it OFF but can enable during onboarding. Docs + customer consent templates coming tomorrow. :tada: :lock:

release-bot: Deploy v2.1.5-supportpods -> private-controlplane-prod completed at 2024-11-22T18:34Z :rocket:

sam_engineering: This looks great. Implementation note: support pods are a short-lived proxy container + token exchange into the tenant VPC. Network isolation enforced via egress-only NAT + iptables rules. We'll surface TTL and scope validation in the Console UI.

jay_security: Reviewed the design. A couple of mandatory items for GA: (1) ephemeral creds must be KMS-wrapped and rotated per-session; (2) FIPS cipher suite must be enforced when tenant flags FIPS-compliance; (3) audit bundles must be immutable and exportable to customer S3/GCS; (4) recorded attestations must include the session policy and consent token. Also adding a short FAQ about legal access to cross-region sessions. cc @nora_ops

maria_support: Support ops request: we need a consent checkbox template + Zendesk macros before we start enabling for customers. Also want a short troubleshooting checklist for failed session creation (common issues: missing route, blocked egress, stale agent version). I'll post PR for macros in the next hour.

nora_ops: Ops runbook (short):
1) Create pod: `redwood supportpod create --tenant <TENANT_ID> --ttl 2h --scopes logs,shell`
2) Confirm consent token in ticket (link to consent template)
3) Validate network: `redwood supportpod check-net --tenant <TENANT_ID>`
4) Monitor session: `kubectl logs -n support-pods support-proxy-<id> -f`
5) Export audit bundle: `redwood audit export --tenant <TENANT_ID> --session <SESSION_ID> --dest s3://customer-audit`
We will add SLOs for session startup time and a rollback play for agent incompatibilities.

elaine_pm: Go-to-customer plan: GA today for new Private tenants. Existing tenants: console opt-in only until 2026-05-01; after that we'll flip the default to OFF with an explicit customer choice during major upgrades. We'll send a customer readiness email + knowledge base tomorrow morning. Internal training for Support & Sales Friday 11:00 PT (calendar invite sent).

jay_security: +1. One reminder: data-residency opt-out must be honored — pods will never cross region unless tenant explicitly sets `allow_cross_region_troubleshooting=true`. Please ensure the Console UI shows that flag clearly.

maria_support: Noted. I'll add the consent checkbox and macros, and coordinate the training slides.

elaine_pm: Thanks team — big win for on-prem support without full remote access. Please escalate any rollbacks or customer blockers into #release-war-room immediately. :heart:
